    Exact compiled boundary for the BGRS 3.7(b) cleavage using its actual stable path representatives. All enriched naturality and linear-algebra choices are discharged. The only supplied source statement is precisely the supplement nonmembership proved in 3.7: each path generator is outside the sum of its endpoint-Jacobson layer and all forbidden cross composites.
